5starmax.us.title: Kiss of the Spider Woman
5starmax.us.description: In a Latin American prison, an emotional relationship evolves between a homosexual and his cellmate, a political radical. - 1985

5starmax.us.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
5starmax.us.description: Baz Luhrmann helped adapt this classic Shakespearean romantic tragedy for the screen, updating the setting to a post-modern city named Verona Beach. In this version, the Capulets and the Montagues are two rival gangs. Juliet is attending a costume ball thrown by her parents. Her father Fulgencio Capulet has arranged her marriage to the boorish Paris as part of a strategic investment plan. Romeo attends the masked ball and he and Juliet fall in love. (Romance, Drama) - 1996

5starmax.us.title: Robin Hood
5starmax.us.description: After the death of Richard the Lion-Hearted, a skilled archer named Robin Longstride travels to Nottingham, where villagers suffer under a despotic sheriff and crippling taxation. He meets and falls in love with a spirited widow, Marion, although she is skeptical of his motives. Hoping to win her heart and save the village, Robin gathers a band of warriors to fight corruption in Nottingham, little knowing they will soon be fighting to save England itself. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Historical drama) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
5starmax.us.description: When Austria's crown prince is found dead, evidence seems to point to suicide. However, detective Sherlock Holmes deduces that the prince was murdered and that the crime is but a piece of a puzzle designed by an evil genius named Moriarty. Holmes and his friend Dr. Watson, who are accompanied by a Gypsy whose life Holmes saved, chase Moriarty across Europe in the hope that they can thwart his plot before it can come to fruition. (Action, Adventure, Mystery) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: The Adjustment Bureau
5starmax.us.description: Just as he is on the brink of winning a Senate seat, politician David Norris meets a ballerina named Elise Sellas. Though David is instantly smitten, mysterious men conspire to keep him away from the beautiful dancer. David learns that he is facing the powerful agents of Fate itself, and glimpsing the future laid out for him, must either accept a predetermined path that does not include Elise or else defy Fate to be with her. (Thriller, Romance, Science fiction, Crime drama) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: It
5starmax.us.description: In 1960, seven preteen outcasts fight an evil demon that poses as a child-killing clown. Thirty years later, they reunite to stop the demon once and for all when it returns to their hometown. (Drama, Fantasy, Horror, Mystery, Thriller) - 1990

5starmax.us.title: Sweet Dreams
5starmax.us.description: Aspiring country singer Patsy Cline (Jessica Lange) is resigned to both her thankless gigs and her unhappy marriage, until she meets the charismatic Charlie Dick (Ed Harris). Eventually leaving her husband to marry Charlie, Patsy temporarily shelves her performing career to be a mother. Later she returns to singing and finds success under manager Randy Hughes (David Clennon). Patsy hits a remarkable stride with a string of hit singles, and has become a full-fledged star when tragedy strikes. (Biography) - 1985

5starmax.us.title: Dim Sum Funeral
5starmax.us.description: In the wake of her death, the embittered children of Chinese-American matriarch Mrs. Xiao (Lisa Lu) begrudgingly return to their childhood home for a bristly -- and brief, they hope -- reunion. But after Xiao's maid and sole confidant, Viola (Talia Shire), reveals her wish to undergo a week-long Buddhist funeral rite, the younger Xiaos -- including plastic surgeon Alexander (Russell Wong) and lesbian actress Meimei (Steph Song) -- have seven days to come to terms with her death, and each other. (Comedy drama) - 2008

5starmax.us.title: Rodan
5starmax.us.description: A bug-eating pterodactyl flies out of a coal mine and wrecks Japan with sonic booms. (Science fiction) - 1957

5starmax.us.title: Hop
5starmax.us.description: Beneath Easter Island, in a giant factory that manufactures the world's Easter candy, the popular rabbit is preparing to pass the mantle to his son, E.B. (Russell Brand). But E.B. has no interest in the job and would rather be a drummer. He runs away to Los Angeles, where an unemployed slacker named Fred O'Hare (James Marsden) accidentally runs into him. Feigning injury, E.B. tricks Fred into giving him shelter, but an oversized chick is planning a coup back on Easter Island. (Family, Holiday, Comedy, Animated) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: The Hobbit
5starmax.us.description: An animated adaptation of J.R.R. Tolkien's tale of the adventures of a hobbit on a quest to regain a dwarf king's gold. (Animated, Fantasy) - 1977

5starmax.us.title: Fantastic Planet
5starmax.us.description: This animated tale follows the relationship between the small human-like Oms and their much larger blue-skinned oppressors, the Draags, who rule the planet of Ygam. While the Draags have long kept Oms as illiterate pets, this hierarchy shifts after an Om boy becomes educated, thanks to a young female Draag. This leads to an Om rebellion, which weakens the Draag control over their race. Will the Oms and the Draags find a way to coexist? Or will they destroy each other? (Animated, Science fiction) - 1973

5starmax.us.title: Head Office
5starmax.us.description: A U.S. senator's son (Judge Reinhold) gets a job at a conglomerate and falls for the chairman's (Eddie Albert) radical daughter. (Comedy) - 1986

5starmax.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
5starmax.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue. (War, Historical drama) - 1987

5starmax.us.title: A History of Violence
5starmax.us.description: When a pair of petty criminals attempt to rob his small-town diner, Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen) quickly and easily kills them both. In the flush of news coverage of Tom's seemingly heroic actions, a threatening stranger named Carl Fogarty (Ed Harris) comes to town, fingering the unassuming family man as long-missing Philadelphia mobster Joey Cusack. To the horror of his wife, Edie (Maria Bello), and teenage son, Jack (Ashton Holmes), Tom finds he must confront his violent past. (Drama, Thriller) - 2005

5starmax.us.title: The Usual Suspects
5starmax.us.description: "The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist," says con man Kint, drawing a comparison to the most enigmatic criminal of all time, Keyser Söze. Kint attempts to convince the feds that the mythic crime lord not only exists, but is also responsible for drawing Kint and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro Harbor - leaving few survivors. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1995

5starmax.us.title: Contagion
5starmax.us.description: When Beth Emhoff returns to Minnesota from a Hong Kong business trip, she attributes the malaise she feels to jet lag. However, two days later, Beth is dead, and doctors tell her shocked husband that they have no idea what killed her. Soon, many others start to exhibit the same symptoms, and a global pandemic explodes. Doctors try to contain the lethal microbe, but society begins to collapse as a blogger fans the flames of paranoia. (Thriller, Drama) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Scanners
5starmax.us.description: Scanners are men and women born with incredible telepathic and telekinetic powers. There are many who exercise the benefits of their special gifts in a safe and judicious manner. However, there is a group of renegade scanners who plan to create a race that will rule the world. (Science fiction, Horror, Thriller) - 1981

5starmax.us.title: Godzilla vs. Megalon
5starmax.us.description: Godzilla and flying cyborg Jet Jaguar meet a giant cockroach and a big black chicken sent by Seatopians. (Science fiction) - 1973

5starmax.us.title: Godzilla vs. Mechagodzilla
5starmax.us.description: An Okinawan monster-god helps Godzilla defeat his bionic double. (Science fiction) - 1974

5starmax.us.title: Walkabout
5starmax.us.description: Under the pretense of having a picnic, a geologist (John Meillon) takes his teenage daughter (Jenny Agutter) and 6-year-old son (Lucien John) into the Australian outback and attempts to shoot them. When he fails, he turns the gun on himself, and the two city-bred children must contend with harsh wilderness alone. They are saved by a chance encounter with an Aboriginal boy (David Gulpilil) who shows them how to survive and in the process underscores the disharmony between nature and modern life. (Adventure) - 1971

5starmax.us.title: Scream
5starmax.us.description: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. (Horror, Comedy) - 1996

5starmax.us.title: Batman
5starmax.us.description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself The Joker (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1989

5starmax.us.title: Batman Returns
5starmax.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1992

antiquesroadshow.us.description: S40 E07 Black Country Living Museum Featuring Black Country Living Museum in Dudley, where surprising finds include a 3,000-year-old baby rattle and a Fabergé treasure destined to become one of the most valuable items ever seen on the show.

antiquesroadshow.us.title: Antiques Roadshow
antiquesroadshow.us.description: S40 E08 Castle Howard 2 Returning to Castle Howard in North Yorkshire for a classic summer roadshow; the range of objects brought for the experts to peruse is as eclectic as the people who own them, from a humble terracotta figurine to a rare jade Buddha.

antiquesroadshow.us.title: Antiques Roadshow
antiquesroadshow.us.description: S40 E09 Floors Castle 1 At Floors Castle in Scotland one lucky visitor learns that a family gift is worth a small fortune, but there is a question mark over some 18th-century glass; Fiona tells the story of this beautiful building.

antiquesroadshow.us.title: Antiques Roadshow
antiquesroadshow.us.description: S40 E10 Helmingham Hall 1 Fiona and the team head to Suffolk to Helmingham Hall that has been home to twenty generations of the Tollemache family; the moated Tudor manor house, with two working drawbridges, is the perfect backdrop for a roadshow brimming with antique finds.

antiquesroadshow.us.title: Antiques Roadshow
antiquesroadshow.us.description: S40 E11 Black Country Living Museum 2 Fiona Bruce and the team return to the Black Country Living Museum in the West Midlands; Susan Rumfitt discovers some jewels fit for a princess; Hilary Kay explores local motor racing history at the Sunbeam Motor Car Company.

antiquesroadshow.us.title: Antiques Roadshow
antiquesroadshow.us.description: S40 E13 Helmingham Hall 2 The team return to Helmingham Hall in Suffolk, where Paul meets a man whose family have painstakingly constructed a working model fairground; Fiona has fun with a unique piece of Donald Trump memorabilia: a vanity set from his private yacht.

antiquesroadshow.us.title: Antiques Roadshow
antiquesroadshow.us.description: S40 E14 Newcastle Civic Centre 1 Fiona and the team are at Newcastle's 1960s Civic Center, an iconic building where everything from the modernist architecture to the public art and the carpets to the chandeliers was conceived by one man.

antiquesroadshow.us.title: Antiques Roadshow
antiquesroadshow.us.description: S40 E15 Osborne House 1 The picturesque location is Queen Victoria's favorite seaside residence, Osborne; as the experts set up their tables overlooking the grand gardens with views of the Solent, visitors bring along treasures including some ordinary looking cutlery.

antiquesroadshow.us.title: Antiques Roadshow
antiquesroadshow.us.description: S40 E17 Cardiff Castle 1 Fiona Bruce and the team visit the iconic castle of the Welsh capital city of Cardiff; the grounds provide the perfect setting, with treasures ranging from a simple pottery jug given as a love token, to an early Hockney print found in a junk shop.

antiquesroadshow.us.title: Antiques Roadshow
antiquesroadshow.us.description: S40 E18 Minehead Railway Station 2 Fiona and the team are at Minehead Railway Station where spirits are high despite the weather; as the sun breaks through, the treasures begin to arrive, including a chair said to have belonged to Henry VIII and a Butlins dance trophy.

antiquesroadshow.us.title: Antiques Roadshow
antiquesroadshow.us.description: S40 E19 Cardiff Castle 2 Fiona Bruce and the team return to Cardiff Castle, where silver specialist Gordon Foster is fascinated by an elaborately decorated Indian flask; John Benjamin reveals that what was thought to be costume jewelry is actually the real thing.

antiquesroadshow.us.title: Antiques Roadshow
antiquesroadshow.us.description: S40 E21 Trelissick 2 Fiona and the team are at Trelissick House and gardens in Cornwall with treasures in all shapes and sizes, from a giant chair and an escape pod from a Vulcan bomber, to a miniature sewing kit that proves the best things do come in little packages.

antiquesroadshow.us.title: Antiques Roadshow
antiquesroadshow.us.description: S40 E22 Helmingham Hall 3 The team return to Helmingham Hall in Suffolk, home to the Tollemache family for 500 years, where treasures include a sapphire ring, a Girl Guide sketch by Robert Baden-Powell and a collection of Native American artifacts.

antiquesroadshow.us.title: Antiques Roadshow
antiquesroadshow.us.description: S40 E23 Abbey Pumping Station 1 Fiona and the team head to Leicester's Museum of Technology, housed in a Victorian sewage pumping station: the Abbey Pumping Station, complete with four working beam engines; Mark Hill casts his expert eye over an abandoned sculpture.

antiquesroadshow.us.title: Antiques Roadshow
antiquesroadshow.us.description: S40 E24 Stormont 2 Fiona Bruce and team are in Belfast at the Parliament Buildings in Stormont Estate; an unloved muffin dish holds a surprise; Justin Croft spots an unread copy of "Ulysses"; John Foster delves into Belfast's 18th-century water system.

antiquesroadshow.us.title: Antiques Roadshow
antiquesroadshow.us.description: S40 E25 Abbey Pumping Station 2 Fiona and the team return to the historic Abbey Pumping Station in Leicester; expert Ronnie Archer-Morgan swoons over some 1960s steel sculptures; books specialist Rupert Powell meets playwright Joe Orton's sister who brings in his typewriter.

antiquesroadshow.us.title: Antiques Roadshow
antiquesroadshow.us.description: Newcastle Civic Centre 2 At Newcastle's Civic Center, Adam Schoon values a child's penny-farthing cycle; rare diaries tell the story of Victorian heroine Grace Darling and her mission to save lives at sea.

antiquesroadshow.us.title: Antiques Roadshow
antiquesroadshow.us.description: Osborne House 2 The team returns for a second helping of finds from the Isle of Wight at Queen Victoria's Italianate seaside residence, Osborne; Richard Price challenges Fiona Bruce to work out how three clocks have changed in value since 1977.

antiquesroadshow.us.title: Antiques Roadshow
antiquesroadshow.us.description: Pioneering Women Special A celebration of the outstanding achievements of some of Britain's most inspirational women, marking 100 years since women won the right to vote in 1918.

antiquesroadshow.us.title: Antiques Roadshow
antiquesroadshow.us.description: World War I Special The team presents from the Etaples Military Cemetery in France with a selection of emotive and poignant World War I items.

antiquesroadshow.us.title: Antiques Roadshow
antiquesroadshow.us.description: S41 E01 Compilation 1 The team take a look back at some of the most memorable finds from the past 40 years, and what happened to the selection of items.

antiquesroadshow.us.title: Antiques Roadshow
antiquesroadshow.us.description: S41 E02 Eltham Palace 1 Two unknown paintings by Diego Rivera; a collection of Gerry Anderson puppets.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E07 Summer Fruits Raymond demonstrates the versatility of the summer's juiciest fruits with a simple but impressive berry-strewn pavlova and a spicy cherry clafoutis where the vibrant fruit is cushioned in a bed of soft, sumptuous pastry.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E08 Summer Greens Raymond celebrates the freshest summer greens, beginning with a simple yet vibrant pistou soup, laden with summer vegetables and bursting with basil, topped with crispy croutons and meltingly rich Parmesan.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 San Francisco to Monterey Rick enjoys sitting on the dock of the bay in San Francisco, tasting legendary dishes like the hangtown fry; San Francisco is also the home of sourdough and where America's love affair with seasonal cooking took hold.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Monterey to San Diego Rick Stein continues traveling down the Californian coastline immortalized by Steinbeck.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 San Diego to Baja California Rick enjoys a hearty steak and eggs American diner special and bids a fond farewell to his trusty Ford Mustang as he heads across what is reputed to be the busiest border crossing in the world.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Guadalajara to Puerto Vallarta Rick lands in the town that gave the world tequila and the metropolis that birthed mariachis and dishes like chili con carne.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Mexico City to Oaxaca Rick Stein visits the Mexican capital to sample the Aztec cuisine.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Oaxaca to Chinantlan Mountains Rick Stein's latest travels take him to Mexico's culinary capital Oaxaca.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Oaxaca to Yucatan Peninsula Rick Stein heads east from Oaxaca to the Yucatán Peninsula, a place once frequented by real pirates of the Caribbean, including Sir Francis Drake.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Corsica and Sardinia Rick Stein discovers sausages and sheep's cheese and explores the locals' passion for chestnuts in Corsica.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 On a misty lagoon in Sardinia Rick watches the fishermen catch mullet using the same methods as the Romans did centuries before. He boards a ferry for Sicily to find, in the heart of Palermo, one of the best pasta dishes he's ever tasted.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Sicily and Puglia Rick travels from Sicily to Puglia.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Corfu Rick departs Italy and makes his way to the Greek island of Corfu, where he attends a family feast; he visits kitchens in restaurants all over the island and learns how to make dishes such as a Greek peasant salad with feta and olives and more.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Mallorca and Catalonia In Mallorca, Rick finds wonderful seafood dishes and the most succulent roast lamb he's ever tasted, while in Barcelona he samples Catalonian food at the famous Boqueria market.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Morocco and Turkey Rick samples the delights of couscous, tagines and mint tea in Moroccan bazaars, before heading along the old silk route to south-eastern Turkey, where he tastes the finest kebabs.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Nisha's family helps her cook chicken dhansak and a Hungarian favorite.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Nisha cooks chicken korma and marinated tandoori monkfish tail on the BBQ.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Kolkata and Chennai Rick explores Bengal and Tamil Nadu, the regions that began Britain's love affair with curry; Rick enjoys the prominence of fish and seafood in their dishes, flavored with mustard in Kolkata and tamarind in Chennai.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Mumbai and Pondicherry Rick explores Mumbai in search of the bombil, the fish that immortalized Bombay Duck; enjoying Parsee hospitality.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Lucknow and Punjab Rick Stein arrives in the cultural city of Lucknow, India; it is reputed to be the curry capital of India.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Rajasthan and Himachal Pradesh Rick Stein visits the royal state of Rajasthan, a land of kings, hilltop forts and palaces, where the local population are serious meat-eaters.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Madurai and Lucknow Rick Stein discovers a five-star hotel in Madurai employing local housewives for genuine home-cooked dishes and enjoys Chettinad Chicken, a dish inspired by spices brought back from both the east and the west by traveling merchants.

buzzr.us.title: Card Sharks
buzzr.us.description: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800. (Game show) - 1978-04-24

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

buzzr.us.title: Card Sharks
buzzr.us.description: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800. (Game show) - 1978-04-24

cinesony.us.title: Dragon Wars
cinesony.us.description: Ethan Kendrick (Jason Behr) descubre que unas criaturas antiguas llamadas Imoogi han regresado a la Tierra, y la única forma de detenerlas es con la ayuda de Sarah (Amanda Brooks). Basada en una leyenda coreana. (Movies, Action) - 2007

cinevault.us.title: 28 Days
cinevault.us.description: The story of Gwen Cummings (Sandra Bullock), a successful New York writer living in the fast lane and everyone's favorite party girl -- until she gets drunk with boyfriend Jasper (Dominic West), borrows her sister's (Elizabeth Perkins) wedding limo and earns herself a stay in court-ordered rehab. (Comedy drama, Movie) - 2000-02-08

cinevault.us.title: Random Hearts
cinevault.us.description: After a plane crash in which both their spouses are killed, Sergeant Dutch Van Den Broeck and Congresswoman Kay Chandler's lives are connected. Their spouses were headed to the same address, with identical keys, under Mr. and Mrs. plane tickets. The investigation leads to startling discoveries and an unexpected romance. (Drama, Movie) - 1999-10-08

cinevault.us.title: The Tourist
cinevault.us.description: During an impromptu trip to Europe to mend a broken heart, math teacher Frank Tupelo (Johnny Depp) finds himself in an extraordinary situation when an alluring stranger, Elise (Angelina Jolie), places herself in his path. Their seemingly innocent flirtation turns into a dangerous game of cat and mouse while various people, who all think that Frank is Elise's thieving paramour, Alexander Pearce, try to capture the pair. (Action, Movie, Romance, Thriller) - 2010-12-09

cinevault.us.title: Obsessed
cinevault.us.description: Things couldn't be better for Derek Charles (Idris Elba). He's just received a big promotion at work, and has a wonderful marriage with his beautiful wife, Sharon (Beyoncé Knowles). However, into this idyllic world steps Lisa (Ali Larter), a temporary worker at Derek's office. Lisa begins to stalk Derek, jeopardizing all he holds dear. (Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2009-04-24

cinevault.us.title: Cold Comes the Night
cinevault.us.description: A motel owner and her daughter are taken hostage by a blind thief to be his eyes while he tracks down his cash. (Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2013-09-20

cinevault.us.title: Cowboy Up
cinevault.us.description: Hank (Kiefer Sutherland) and Ely Braxton (Marcus Thomas) are brothers and rivals. They're each haunted by the specter of their dad, Reid (Pete Postlethwaite), a famous bull rider turned absent father. Hank is a rodeo clown who breeds bulls; Ely is a brash young rider who won't let anything -- not even life-threatening injuries -- keep him out of the ring. When rodeo sweetheart Celia (Daryl Hannah) gets between them, sibling rivalry grows volatile and loyalties are tested. (Drama, Movie) - 2000

cinevault.us.title: The Principal
cinevault.us.description: The new principal (James Belushi) of a drug-infested high school joins with a security guard (Louis Gossett Jr.) to clean it up. (Comedy drama, Movie) - 1987

cinevault.us.title: Blue Thunder
cinevault.us.description: Frank Murphy is a courageous and honorable Los Angeles police officer who is chosen to test run Blue Thunder, a high-tech experimental attack helicopter. cinevault.us.title: Runaway
cinevault.us.description: In this advanced society, most homes have robots that perform everyday menial duties. Every so often, one malfunctions, and Sgt. Jack Ramsay (Tom Selleck), an expert in rogue machines, must deal with it. When he and his new partner, Karen Thompson (Cynthia Rhodes), investigate a robot-involved homicide, they discover strange computer chips. Rather than a malfunction, someone is programming the robots to kill. The police must find whoever is behind the murder before more harm is done. (Movie, Science fiction) - 1984

cinevault.us.title: Solo

When his creators, including Gen. Haynes (Barry Corbin), attempt to bring him back, he flees. But the military doesn't give up. They send an upgraded android into the field to take Solo -- and the villagers -- down. (Action, Movie) - 1996-08-23

She sets out to track down the real killer, and, as the trial proceeds, makes an unlikely ally in Eddie Sanger (Dennis Quaid), a jury member. When they aren't in court, the two investigate the case and manage to uncover a massive conspiracy. (Movie, Thriller) - 1987-10-23

Joined by their trouble-making uncle "Black Jack" (Ben Johnson), Mac and Dal relentlessly pursue the criminals to rescue their relatives. (Movie, Western) - 1982-09-28

cinevault.us.title: Buddy

But as Buddy grows older and larger, Trudy is unable to restrain him from turning increasingly violent. (Adventure, Children, Comedy drama, Movie) - 1997-06-06

cinevault.us.title: Side Out

But when Wiley is injured, Monroe partners with Zack. They're underdogs in a tough field of competitors, but Monroe and Zack feel they're up to the challenge. (Action, Movie) - 1990-09-19

Hoping to find out from Gauche where the gang buried their spoils before Kuroda can kill him, Link tries to escape from the samurai. (Western) - 1971

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Mystery on Lockhart Road

fifthgear.us.description: S13 E09 Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out which is quickest, the VW Golf GTI or Subaru Impreza WRX; Jonny Smith proves there are still some cars that you can buy for under $1,500.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E10 Vicki takes the Focus RS and the Escort Cosworth to find out once and for all which handles best around a track; Jason drives the Grand Tourer and delivers his verdict whether the £78,000 asking price would represent money well spent.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E01 Tim Shaw joins the team, and he's been specially tasked with standing up for the beleaguered motorist; Jason Plato and Tiff Needell go head-to-head on the track to find out which car is fastest.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E02 Tiff Needell takes two coupes onto the Fifth Gear track, the Mazda RX8 and Nissan 350Z; Vicki Butler-Henderson spends a day with Formula One star Lewis Hamilton; Tom Ford is the lucky man behind the wheel of the facelifted Mercedes SL63 AMG.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E03 Jason Plato races two estates head to head; Vicki Butler-Henderson pits the new Pro-Ceed against the VW Golf; Jonny Smith picks up an amazing luxury car for £1000 or less; Tiff Needell runs the most exciting car vs. bike race to date.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E04 Jason Plato pitches a lunatic Honda Civic Mugen RR imported from Japan against a Honda S2000 sports car from the UK; Jonny Smith tests the VW Passat CC v Mercedes CLS; Tiff Needell takes to the track to test the brand new KTM X-Bow.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E05 Tiff and Jason race two V8 mega-saloons. Tom has the only television test of the Dodge Challenger.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E06 Tim Shaw tests whether manufacturers' claimed 0-62mph acceleration times are actually true or not; Vicki Butler-Henderson heads out to the track in two Porsches.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E07 Tom Ford tests the brand new Ford Fiesta; Vicki Butler-Henderson and Tiff Needell challenge each other on two wheels; Jonny shows us three great cars we could all suddenly afford to buy if we were to all stop drinking.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E08 Jason and Tiff battle against each other in the purest form of motor-sport: karting; Dirk Benedict joins Jonny Smith in a luxury road test with a difference; Tom Ford tests the Renault Laguna.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E09 Jason meets Moto GP star James Toseland in a feature where "Fifth Gear" makes a sports star's dream come true.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E05 Tom Ford puts the Grande Punto Abarth through its hot hatch paces; Tim Shaw finds out if it's possible to save huge amounts of money by servicing a car yourself; Bruno Senna is a special guest presenter.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S15 E01 Tiff and Jason head for the racetrack in the KTM X-Bow and Lotus 2-Eleven; Jonny investigates the smarter and apparently plusher qualities to be found in the latest Golf; Tom conducts a crash test which is essential viewing for all families.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S15 E02 Jason pits the tiny Renault Sport Twingo 133 against the Renault 5 GT Turbo; Tom finds out Vauxhall's replacement for the Vectra; Tim relives the terror of his driving test to find out why fewer people than ever are passing their test.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S15 E03 Jason pits two diesel coupes against each other; Jonny braves the freezing weather to show off three cabriolets, with a budget of just £5,000; Tom puts the Ford Fiesta against the Seat Ibiza in three tests; Tiff drives the Lamborghini Gallardo.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S15 E04 Vicki talks with the young rally sensation Tom Cave; Jason is at the annual Race of Champions.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S15 E05 Jason and BBC Radio 1 star Comedy Dave recreate a Ford Capri car chase scene from '70s UK TV show "The Professionals." Tim tests different car polishes.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S15 E06 Tiff pits Renault's Mégane hatch against a Caterham CDX sports car; Tim delves into the murky world of car crime; Jonny gives a consumer review of the new Ford Ka.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S15 E07 Tiff tests hatches including the Ford Focus RS; Vicki looks at a second-hand Lotus Elise; Quentin examines the personalized number plate market.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Vicki meets 12 times Motor Trials champion and British motorcycling legend Dougie Lampkin; Jonny investigates another way of making cash from old cars; Jason takes the Ford Focus RS in the first TV drive of Ford's awesome new hot hatch.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S15 E09 Tim finds out which car washes are effective -- and which ones can permanently damage a car's paint.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S15 E10 The Vauxhall Astra GTE 16v and Ford Escort RS Turbo take on the Fifth Gear test track.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S16 E01 Featuring a death-defying loop-the-loop stunt, a race against David Coulthard, and a test to see if buying an old car can beat the credit crunch.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S16 E02 Jonny Smith compares the Audi A5 Cabriolet and the BMW 3 Series convertible; while Tim Shaw investigates the accuracy of the combined economy cycle.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S16 E03 Tiff and Jason open the show with a dogfight, heading to the track in the brand-new BMW Z4 and Porsche Boxster; Jonny gets behind the wheel of what could be the most perfect car in the world.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S16 E04 The Mini Cooper Cabriolet and Mazda MX-5 battle to see which drop-top is the quickest to get home when it rains.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S16 E05 Tiff and Jason enter an off-road playground in a variety of tanks.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S16 E06 Tiff tests out the Caterham Roadsport 175 by becoming a medical courier; Torchwood star John Barrowman gets a crash course in rally driving.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S16 E07 Jason and Tiff race a pair of double-decker buses; Tiff gives rally-car driving lessons to John Barrowman; Jason takes the Audi TT R5 for a spin.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S16 E08 Tim samples the craze for car share clubs; Jason arranges a treat at Silverstone for chef and car fanatic James Martin.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S16 E09 Tiff and Jonny have fun with four tiny hot hatches: the 500 Abarth, Mitsubishi Colt Ralliart, Renault Sport Twingo and Suzuki Swift Sport.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S16 E10 Tiff puts the Caterham Roadsport 175 through an unusual test that checks out the vehicle's practicality and performance.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S17 E01 Jonny Smith examines the Smart ForTwo and Toyota iQ; Jason Plato is in Italy behind the wheel of the supercar of the moment.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S17 E02 Jason rips through Italy in the Gallardo Superleggera; Vicki gets under the skin of the Nissan Cube; Jonny examines Volvo's S80 DRIVe with the help of a yacht; Tiff and Jason do battle in the R8 Spyder and Porsche 911 Turbo Cabriolet.

filmriseaction.us.title: Arlington Road
filmriseaction.us.description: A U.S. history professor (Jeff Bridges), obsessed with radical groups, thinks his new neighbors (Tim Robbins, Joan Cusack) may be domestic terrorists. - 1999

filmriseaction.us.title: JCVD
filmriseaction.us.description: Weary action star Jean-Claude Van Damme (Jean-Claude Van Damme) returns to Belgium to find relief from his troubles but instead stumbles into a bank robbery. (Comedy, Crime drama, Action) - 2008

filmriseaction.us.title: Operator
filmriseaction.us.description: When the daughter of a dispatcher and a cop is kidnapped, they are forced to follow the kidnapper's rules and have to choose to save their daughter or the city. (Action, Drama, Thriller) - 2015

filmriseaction.us.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
filmriseaction.us.description: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men. (Thriller, Historical drama, War) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: Freejack
filmriseaction.us.description: Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place. (Science fiction) - 1992

filmriseaction.us.title: The Contract
filmriseaction.us.description: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire. (Thriller) - 2006

filmriseaction.us.title: Assault on Precinct 13
filmriseaction.us.description: When the LAPD kills several members of the South Central gang Street Thunder, the remaining members avenge themselves by way of a bloody war waged against cops and citizens alike. Caught in the crossfire is Lt. Ethan Bishop (Austin Stoker), who's managing a skeleton crew at the local and soon-to-be-closed police precinct. As the gang members close in, Bishop forms an unlikely alliance with a group of prisoners in order to defend the station and the lives of everyone in it. (Action) - 1976

filmriseaction.us.title: Dillinger and Capone
filmriseaction.us.description: Dillinger's (Martin Sheen) reported 1934 death gives him a new life, but Chicago mobster Capone (F. Murray Abraham) wants him to pull one more heist. (Historical drama) - 1995

filmriseaction.us.title: Guns of Redemption
filmriseaction.us.description: Searching for redemption, a mysterious gunslinger with a violent past tries to save a young woman from vicious men who run a traveling brothel. (Western, Action) - 2025

filmriseaction.us.title: Gunfight at Rio Bravo
filmriseaction.us.description: A mysterious Russian gunslinger aids a marshal and a sheriff in a standoff with an outlaw gang who have invaded their town. (Western) - 2023

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S06 E04 Nobody Likes Me Martin takes baby James to playgroup, where he is forced to sing along with the other moms; Al signs up for a dating website; Bert finds Jennifer in the bathroom with a needle.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S06 E05 The Practice Around the Corner Mrs. Tishell returns to the village; Martin has to work out what is wrong with beachcomber Lorna; Al and Morwenna have Internet dating disasters.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S06 E06 Hazardous Exposure Martin's mother returns to Portwenn; questions about asbestos cause panic; Bert has a question for Jennifer.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S06 E07 Listen With Mother Martin helps Louisa hand out awards at school; showdown between Ruth and Margaret; Mike has a shady revelation from his past.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S06 E08 Departure Louisa has news for Martin; disaster hits at Bert and Jennifer's engagement party; Al has a business proposition for Ruth.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S01 E01 Going Bodmin Martin's first patient is a man who has grown breasts; Martin is forced off the road on his way out of the village.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S01 E02 Gentlemen Prefer Though Martin has opened his surgery, his patients seem to treat it more as a social hangout; Martin is forced to fire Elaine for incompetence.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S01 E03 S... Happens When a nasty stomach bug sweeps through Portwenn, Martin takes to the radio to alert residents to the danger, with unforeseen consequences.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S01 E04 The Portwenn Effect Louisa invites Martin to the Portwenn Players Dance; Martin makes a house call to a park ranger who claims to have a six-foot red squirrel as a friend.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S01 E05 Of All the Harbors in All the Towns Martin's Aunt Joan wants to rekindle a romance with an old flame who is suffering from a life-threatening heart condition; Al tries to woo Elaine.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S01 E06 Haemophobia Martin tries to warn a woman about the dangers of sun bathing, but ends up offending her; gossip about the blood phobia circulates.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S02 E01 Old Dogs Louisa's ex returns to Portwenn hoping for a reunion; Martin sees a patient who has a history of self-injury; Elaine's cousin, Pauline, takes a job at the surgery.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S02 E02 In Loco Louisa is up for promotion to head teacher, but Martin is on the board of governors and may go against her.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S02 E03 Blood Is Thicker Martin's house call to the home of the Flint brothers leads to a diagnosis of food poisoning; Al learns that Bert is not his natural father.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S02 E04 Aromatherapy Martin must treat an elderly man with a horrible smell; a local radio host appears to have a drinking problem; Julie Mitchell arrives in Portwenn.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S02 E05 Always on My Mind Martin is blamed when a patient dies during an examination; Joan urges Martin to explain the circumstances surrounding Helen's death to the widower.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S02 E06 The Family Way Martin is surprised and puzzled when his parents suddenly arrive for a visit; Martin's examination of a woman leads to a surprise diagnosis.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S02 E07 Out of the Woods Mark's stag night plans go awry when he is bitten by a snake, and rescue lies in the hand of Stewart, the park ranger.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S02 E08 Erotomania Martin urges Mrs. Tishell to remove the collar she's worn for years; career disagreements lead Louisa to break up with Danny; a man from the Salvation Army arrives in Portwenn.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S03 E01 The Apple Doesn't Fall A new police officer, who has narcolepsy, replaces Mark Mylow; Martin treats a girl who's been taking her mother's diet pills.

filmriseclassictv.us.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
filmriseclassictv.us.description: After striking oil and becoming millionaires, the Clampett family moves from the Ozarks to Beverly Hills, where a banker tries to prevent them from frittering away their new-found wealth.

filmriseclassictv.us.title: Bonanza
filmriseclassictv.us.description: Little Joe tries teaching a deaf girl sign language after seeing her get mistreated by her father.

filmriseclassictv.us.title: Bonanza
filmriseclassictv.us.description: Ben Cartwright is the patriarch of an all-male Nevada ranching family. Set during and after the Civil War, "Bonanza" is the story of life on the family's thousand-acre spread, known as the Ponderosa, near Virginia City. Ben has his three sons, each with a different (and deceased) mother. Serious eldest son Adam hopes to follow in his father's footsteps; middle son Hoss is a gentle giant -- physically strong, but sometimes naive; and youngest son Little Joe is the most impetuous and romantic of the offspring. (Drama, Western) - 1959-09-12

retroplex.us.title: After Dark, My Sweet
retroplex.us.description: After escaping from a mental hospital, drifting ex-boxer Kid Collie (Jason Patric) meets an alcoholic widow, Fay (Rachel Ward), who entices him into performing maintenance work at her estate. When crooked Uncle Bud (Bruce Dern) joins the two, Fay's darker side begins to appear. Bud and Fay concoct a scheme to kidnap the son of a local wealthy family and have Collie carry out the dirty work, to which the troubled ex-boxer agrees, but he soon has second thoughts. (Crime drama) - 1990

retroplex.us.title: Night of the Living Dead

retroplex.us.title: Nowhere to Hide

retroplex.us.title: Stars Over Texas
retroplex.us.description: Cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) have come to the end of a tough cattle drive, but, instead of the rancher they were expecting, they're welcomed by his sister, young Terry Lawrence (Shirley Patterson). It seems that Terry's brother and one of his employees were wounded by gun-toting thugs. Eddie and Soapy realize that they'll need to get to the bottom of things, so they devise a clever plan to lure the bad guys back to the scene. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Thunder Town
retroplex.us.description: Falsely accused of bank robbery, Jim Brandon (Bob Steele) is released from jail after his supposed criminal partner commits suicide. Back home, he finds that, aside from his stalwart friends, Betty Morgan (Ellen Hall) and Utah McGirk (Syd Saylor), most people in his small town still believe he's guilty. Drawn into a land dispute with Dunc Rankin (Edward Howard) over his own and Betty's ranches, Jim also discovers that his dead friend may have been murdered. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Border Feud
retroplex.us.description: A feud has broken out over control of a Nevada gold mine, and Sheriff Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) realizes that he needs a steady hand by his side. Good thing Fuzzy is pals with Cheyenne Davis (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), an out-of-towner who specializes in fighting crime. Beckoned by Fuzzy, Cheyenne arrives just as local beauty Carol Condon (Gloria Marlen) is taken captive by one of the warring parties. Cheyenne and Fuzzy will have to act fast in order to free her and defuse the tension. (Western) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: The Westward Trail
retroplex.us.description: City slicker Ann (Phyllis Planchard) and her little brother Tom (Steve Drake) leave Chicago and buy a ranch out West, and Ann struggles to run things. She meets Larson (Bob Duncan), a crooked local saloon keeper who woos her, but he also wants her land so he can get to the silver that's located on it. As part of his effort to grab all the land he can, Larson kills the town sheriff and assumes his position, alarming good-guy cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), who swoops in and tries to rescue Ann. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Paradise Canyon
retroplex.us.description: Rough-and-tumble federal agent John Wyatt (John Wayne) receives an unusual undercover assignment: He must infiltrate the ranks of an Arizona-based medicine show. Wyatt's boss suspects the show's shifty-eyed proprietor, ex-convict Dr. Carter (Earle Hodgins), of running a massive counterfeiting operation. With the full cooperation of the local authorities, Wyatt poses as a sharpshooter and begins his investigation -- only to fall for Carter's beautiful daughter, Linda (Marion Burns). (Western) - 1935

retroplex.us.title: Under California Stars
retroplex.us.description: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Black Hills
retroplex.us.description: When their father is shot by Dan Kirby (Terry Frost) after discovering a gold mine on his ranch, Larry Hadley (Steve Drake) and his sister, Janet (Shirley Patterson), ask foreman Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) for help in retaining their land. Eddie's arrival with sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) disrupts Dan's plans to take over the property. Desperate to obtain the ranch, Dan blackmails accountant Tuttle (Bill Fawcett) into forging a document that will help him take control. (Western) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
retroplex.us.description: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor. (Western) - 1949

retroplex.us.title: Panhandle
retroplex.us.description: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown. (Western) - 1948

tntwest.us.title: Dr. Seuss' How the Grinch Stole Christmas
tntwest.us.description: Based on the beloved children's book by Dr. Seuss, "How the Grinch Stole Christmas" follows the exploits of the title character who is infuriated by the celebration he sees down in Whoville each year at Christmastime. He vows to stop it and -- dressed as Santa -- drives a sleigh into town on Christmas Eve, removing all traces of the impending celebration. He watches gleefully from his perch on the mountain above, sure that when the Whos awake and see that their holiday decorations, gifts and feast are gone, they will be sad. To his surprise, the Whos celebrate anyway, leading to an unexpected response from the Grinch. (Animated, Children, Holiday, Special, Comedy) - 1966-12-18

tntwest.us.title: The Year Without a Santa Claus
tntwest.us.description: Sidelined by a nasty cold and feeling unneeded, Santa decides not to make his annual Christmas journey. Elves Jingle and Jangle scour the world to find people who still believe, hoping to convince the jolly old elf to make his trip anyway. They run into trouble in Southtown, however, and the only way they can get out of their predicament is to make it snow in the warm climate. Meanwhile, Santa sees evidence that people do still believe, and a little girl's touching letter prompts him to pack up the sleigh and head out on his annual trek, making a special stop in the now-snowy Southtown. (Animated, Children, Holiday, Special, Fantasy) - 1974-12-10

700407.description: Monty is back at Longmeadow, getting stuck into more seasonal tasks. Joe Swift heads to Houghton Lodge Gardens in Hampshire renowned for its walled kitchen garden and heritage fruit collection.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: As Monty brings in the summer harvest, he gives advice on what to sow to keep the crops coming up to the end of Autumn. Carol Klein visits a woman who is losing her eyesight and gives her recommendations of plants that will be a feast for her senses.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty plants tender perennials, including salvias and gingers, in the Jewel Garden, brings his citrus plants out from their winter protection and plants primulas in his new bog garden. As tulip season reaches its glorious peak, Rachel de Thame visits a dazzling display of this spring favourite at a garden in Gloucestershire, and Joe Swift checks out a pub garden with a difference in East Sussex.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Gardeners' World comes from the RHS Malvern Spring Festival. Adam Frost and Arit Anderson reveal the highlights of the show gardens and this year's must-have flowers and plants on display in the Floral Marquee.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: There's been a huge surge of interest in houseplants, so Frances Tophill and Nick Bailey celebrate the joys of indoor gardening from Oxford Botanic Garden. Rachel de Thame visits a nursery in Devon who specialise in growing orchids.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty shows the range of vegetables that can be easily grown in containers if you are short on space, moves ornamental grasses and sows zinnias. Nick Bailey gives us an insight into the bearded iris in Buckinghamshire.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty Don shows how to get the best from tomatoes planted in grow bags, Adam Frost tackles planting in a shady border, and Frances Tophill meets a couple who've created a garden inspired by their travels.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: A single mum of two in Redditch, Holly's garden has turned into a virtual jungle. Can the intrepid threesome come up with a plan to give this family a safe and fun place to play?

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: Charlie Dimmock and Harry and David Rich start with a clean slate in Rutland, and come to the aid of Manjinder. She wants to create an interactive and colourful space to pass her love of gardening on to her two small nephews. Can the team make it happen on her small budget?

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: Charlie Dimmock and the Rich Brothers travel to Andover. Animal-lover Sue would like to share her garden with the hedgehogs who live in the neighbourhood, so which designer will create a space both safe and beautiful?

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty plants for pollinators in the Wildlife Garden and trims his box topiary cones. He also takes succulent leaf cuttings and continues the summer veg harvest. Meanwhile, Carol Klein visits stunning Italian-influenced gardens in Gloucestershire.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Adam Frost is at home sharing his love of ornamental grasses, tackling the problem of building a patio on a slope and giving some inspiration on what to plant at the base of a wall. In Margate, the team visit a man who has come up with a unique way of using a shed roof to grow vegetables, and they travel to Swansea to meet inspirational gardener Sue Kent, who shows how she has designed her garden to enable her to garden successfully despite her upper limb difference.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: The team celebrate the bounty our gardens have to offer at this time of year as Carol Klein gathers wild blackberries, Monty Don is at Longmeadow, and we join a champion vegetable grower in Yorkshire as he prepares for the biggest show of the season.

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: Monty travels to two corners of the country where the challenges he faces are very different. On the south coast he is presented with a front garden ravaged by salty winds, and in Snowdonia he helps a mountainside garden.

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: Monty faces some of the most surprising plans yet - a Norwegian garden complete with waterfalls to be fashioned out of a tiny back yard in Dorset, and nothing less than a Japanese tea garden to be created out of a patch of ground in Bromley.

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: Monty helps two families create dream gardens that are as much for the children as for the adults. In Doncaster, Nikki and John want a garden full of edible plants and fruit.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty turns his attention to the containers in the jewel garden, plants courgettes and clematis and checks up on his bees. Arit Anderson meets a woman on a mission to green up unloved and neglected outdoor spaces in west London, and Nick Bailey continues his journey through the world of the iris, this time turning his attention to Siberian and water irises.

classica.us.title: Music in the Air
classica.us.description: Millionen Menschen sehen sich Live-Übertragungen von Konzerten im Fernsehen an, beispielsweise das Neujahrskonzert. Die Dokumentation zeigt, welche Möglichkeiten das Fernsehen bietet, einem breiten Publikum klassische Musik näherzubringen. - 2012

classica.us.title: Eine Hommage an Wien
classica.us.description: Am 9. März 2011 zollten die Wiener Philharmoniker ihrer Heimatstadt mit einem Walzer-Konzert Tribut.

classica.us.title: Fantasymphony: One Concert to Rule them all
classica.us.description: Ein beeindruckendes Konzerterlebnis, das mit einer Mischung aus spektakulären Sound- und Lichteffekten eine ganz besondere Atmosphäre schafft. Mit der Unterstützung eines Chors werden verschiedene Filmmusikstücke komplett neu vertont. (Music, Concert) - 2020

classica.us.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 4
classica.us.description: Gustav Mahlers Sinfonie Nr. 4, komponiert zwischen 1899 und 1901, schildert die kindliche Vorstellung vom Himmel, ein zentrales Thema, das den unschuldigen und lyrischen Charakter des Werkes prägt. (Special, Music) - 2026-02-28

classica.us.title: Heavenly Voices - Farinellis Vermächtnis
classica.us.description: Als "Kastraten" werden männliche Sänger bezeichnet, die mit glockenklarer Stimme Tonhöhen des Soprans erreichen können, weil man sie noch vor dem Stimmbruch kastriert. Die Dokumentation beschäftigt sich mit dem Aufstieg bekannter Kastraten in der Geschichte und den Umständen, die ihre Karriere möglich machten. Außerdem sprechen die zwei Kontratenoren Max Emanuel Cencic und Philippe Jaroussky über die Musikentwicklung im Barock. (Documentary, Music) - 2012

classica.us.title: Faurés Requiem
classica.us.description: 2024 jährt sich der 100. Todestag von Gabriel Fauré, einem der herausragendsten und einflussreichsten Komponisten, der Lehrer von Maurice Ravel, Georges Enescu, Nadia Boulanger und vielen anderen war. (Special) - 2026-06-06

classica.us.title: Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, op. 26
classica.us.description: Die Sendung zeigt eine Aufführung von Schumanns "Faschingsschwank aus Wien, op. 26". (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2023-12-12

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Letzte Sonate Op. 109, 110 & 111
classica.us.description: Seine drei letzten Sonaten widmet Beethoven den intimen Dynamiken der menschlichen Seele, die von Verzweiflung bis Verwandlung reichen. Im Film werden die Musikwerke mit Szenen in verlassenen Schlössern untermalt, die an Einsamkeit erinnern. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2019-11-23

classica.us.title: Glass - Doppelkonzert für Klavier
classica.us.description: Im Rahmen einer Zusammenarbeit mit dem berühmten Komponisten und unter Begleitung des Orchestre de Paris spielen die begabten, französischen Pianistinnen Katia und Marielle Labèque die Europapremiere von Glass' Doppelklavierkonzert. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2019-11-09

classica.us.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Halbfinale I: Arisa Onoda
classica.us.description: Pianistin Arisa Onoda und das CMIM-Ensemble führen den ersten Satz, Allegro molto moderato, aus Gabriel Faurés Klavierquartett Nr. 1 in c-Moll, Op. 15, auf. Die Aufführung wurde in der Bourgie Hall des Montreal Museum of Fine Arts aufgenommen. (Event, Music, Classical) - 2025-04-01

classica.us.title: The Unanswered Ives
classica.us.description: Charles Ives ist ein Mann der Dissonanzen - und das in fast allen Bereichen seines Lebens. Seit seiner Kindheit gilt seine Liebe dem Spiel mit der Musik. Doch Charles wurde zu einer Zeit geboren, als man klassische Musiker für Memmen hielt. (Special, Documentary) - 2019-09-22

classica.us.title: Schumann - 2. Klaviersonate in g-Moll, op. 22
classica.us.description: In dieser Aufführung präsentiert Riccardo Schwartz Schumanns Klaviersonate Nr. 2 in g-Moll, Op. 22. Es beginnt mit einem energischen ersten Satz, gefolgt von einem wunderschönen, langsamen Andantino nach Schumanns Lied "Im Herbste". (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2024-01-09

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 2
classica.us.description: Mahlers Auferstehungssinfonie, komponiert zwischen 1888 und 1894, ist ein monumentales Werk in fünf Sätzen, das Themen wie Tod und Auferstehung erforscht. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2026-02-07

classica.us.title: Clara Haskil - Das Geheimnis der Interpretin
classica.us.description: Für Freunde und Musiker war und ist die Schweizer Klaviervirtuosin Clara Haskil eine Interpretin, die wie keine andere Maßstäbe gesetzt hat. Anhand von Klaviereinspielungen, Briefen und Interviews zeigt der Film die Musikerin in neuem Licht. (Special, Documentary, Biography, Art) - 2017-08-27

classica.us.title: Bach - 2. Partita für Violin (BWV 1004)
classica.us.description: Die deutsche Geigerin Isabelle Faust spielt dieses Mal zwei beeindruckende Solowerke für die Violine. So spielt sie von Johann Sebastian Bach die Partita Nummer 2 in d-Moll BWV 1004 sowie auch die Sonate Nr. 3 in C-Dur BWV 1005. (Special, Music, Event) - 2023-06-01

classica.us.title: Beethoven - 1. Klavierkonzert, Op. 15
classica.us.description: Lars Vogt ist Solist in einer Aufführung von Beethovens erstem Klavierkonzert. Das Orchestre de Paris wird von Herbert Blomstedt dirigiert. Die Aufnahme entstand 2013 im Salle Pleyel in Paris. (Music) - 2020-03-22

classica.us.title: Martinů - Concertino für Klaviertrio & orchester
classica.us.description: Das italienisch-schweizerische Ensemble Trio des Alpes und das Orchestra da Camera di Mantova tun sich zusammen in dieser Aufführung des Concertino für Klaviertrio und Streichorchester, H. 232, des tschechischen Komponisten Bohuslav Martinů. Diese Aufführung wurde am 21. Januar 2016 im Teatro Bibiena in Mantua, Italien, aufgenommen. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-10-01

classica.us.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 10
classica.us.description: Mahlers 10. Symphonie ist ein unvollendetes Werk, das der Komponist bei seinem Tod hinterließ und das seine letzte emotionale Reise von Qual und Herzschmerz zu einer vorbehaltlosen Akzeptanz des Lebens und der menschlichen Liebe darstellt. (Special) - 2026-04-18

classica.us.title: Schönheit ist ein Verbrechen: Mendelssohn & Brahms
classica.us.description: Teodor Currentzis dirigiert sein Musikensemble MusicAeterna und die Violinspielerin Patricia Kopatchinskaja in einem Konzertprogramm. Thema ist die Suche nach einer neuen Definition von Schönheit. Brahms und Mendelssohn werden in neues Licht gerückt. (Special, Music, Concert) - 2020-04-01

moviesphere.us.title: Rambo
moviesphere.us.description: Having long-since abandoned his life as a lethal soldier, John Rambo (Sylvester Stallone) lives a solitary life near the Thai border. The missionaries have not returned and although he is reluctant to embrace violence again, Rambo sets out to rescue the captives from the Burmese army. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Thriller, War) - 2008-01-25

With the odds against them, Barney and his team are hell-bent on payback and cut a path of destruction through opposing forces, only to encounter an unexpected threat: six pounds of weapons-grade plutonium. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Thriller) - 2012-08-16

Now, Stonebanks is back, and he's on a mission to end the Expendables. Ross decides that the way to fight old blood is with new blood, so he assembles a team of younger, faster, more tech-savvy recruits. The battle to topple Stonebanks becomes a clash of old-school methods vs. high-tech expertise. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Thriller) - 2014-08-05

outlaw.us.title: The Train Robbers
outlaw.us.description: A proud widow hires a Civil War veteran to help recover the gold her late husband stole from Wells Fargo. - 1973

outlaw.us.title: Dodge City
outlaw.us.description: A Texas cattle agent witnesses first hand the brutal lawlessness of Dodge City and takes the job of sheriff to clean the town up. - 1939

outlaw.us.title: Montana
outlaw.us.description: Aussie shepherd Morgan Lane (Errol Flynn) moves all the way to Montana in hopes of finding the perfect terrain for raising his sheep, but the local ranchers aren't keen on sharing their land with outsiders. Before long, Morgan clashes with powerful cattleman Rodney Ackroyd, and their rivalry is only intensified when Ackroyd's fiancée, Maria (Alexis Smith), has eyes for Morgan. However, her sympathies still lie with her lover, and it seems that only a gunfight can settle the conflict. (Western) - 1950

outlaw.us.title: Virginia City
outlaw.us.description: Near the end of the Civil War, Julia Hayne (Miriam Hopkins) travels to Libby Prison to convince Cmdr. Vance Irby (Randolph Scott) to help transport gold from Virginia City to the South. Union intelligence agent Kerry Bradford (Errol Flynn) breaks out of the prison and, learning of the plot for the gold, travels to Nevada, meeting Julia on the way. Sensing Julia is attracted to Kerry, Vance asks her to help set a trap while desperados led by Murrell (Humphrey Bogart) also close in on the gold. (Western) - 1940

outlaw.us.title: Wild Rovers
outlaw.us.description: Tired of his job at a ranch owned by Walter Buckman (Karl Malden), Frank Post (Ryan O'Neal) wants to pull a heist, and when his much older coworker, Ross Bodine (William Holden), sees nothing better on the horizon, the cowboys agree to team up for the crime. After filling their pockets with loot from a local bank, Frank and Ross ride toward what they hope is freedom. But the younger Buckmans, Paul (Joe Don Baker) and John (Tom Skerritt), pursue them over the rough land of the Southwest. (Western) - 1971

outlaw.us.title: The Dawn Rider
outlaw.us.description: John Mason (John Wayne) suffers a cruel homecoming when he witnesses his father's murder as he rides into town. Incensed, he chases after the killers, but he suffers a gunshot wound that cuts his pursuit short. Alice Gordon (Marion Burns) sees to his injury, and Mason is taken by her kindness and beauty. But things turn sour when her beau, Ben (Reed Howes), becomes jealous. After Mason discovers the men who killed his father, his plan for a duel is sabotaged by Ben, who has been manipulated. (Western) - 1935

outlaw.us.title: Tension at Table Rock
outlaw.us.description: When locals are wrongfully led to believe that Wes Tancred murdered a gunslinger in cold blood, they exile the innocent man. Tancred sets off in search of a new start and arrives in the dusty hamlet of Table Rock -- only to find his reputation has preceded him. To avoid trouble, Tancred uses an assumed name. But, when Sheriff Fred Miller talks of trouble at the hands of a violent gang, Tancred agrees to be deputized, and struggles for his shot at redemption. (Western) - 1956

outtvproud.us.title: I Could Never Be Your Woman
outtvproud.us.description: A professional woman (Michelle Pfeiffer) falls for a younger man (Paul Rudd), while her daughter falls in love for the first time. - 2007

outtvproud.us.title: Freeway
outtvproud.us.description: Following the arrest of her mother, Ramona (Amanda Plummer), young Vanessa Lutz (Reese Witherspoon) decides to go in search of her estranged grandmother. On the way, she is given a ride by school counselor Bob Wolverton (Kiefer Sutherland). During the journey, Lutz begins to realize that Bob is the notorious I-5 Killer and manages to escape by shooting him several times. Wounded but still very much alive, Bob pursues Lutz across the state in this modern retelling of Little Red Riding Hood. (Thriller, Comedy) - 1996

outtvproud.us.title: True Crime
outtvproud.us.description: Mary (Alicia Silverstone), a precocious high school senior, longs to be a cop. She idolizes her late father, a policeman, and intently studies her favorite magazine, "True Crime." When a classmate dies and the case remains unsolved, Mary becomes obsessed, pestering a local cop (Bill Nunn). When she meets police cadet Tony (Kevin Dillon), the two decide to take up the investigation themselves, and romantic sparks soon fly. But Mary has no idea of the danger that awaits her. (Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery, Horror) - 1995

outtvproud.us.title: You Hurt My Feelings
outtvproud.us.description: A novelist's long-standing marriage is suddenly upended when she overhears her husband give his honest reaction to her latest book. (Comedy drama, Romance) - 2023

outtvproud.us.title: Let Me In
outtvproud.us.description: Bullied at school, neglected at home and incredibly lonely, 12-year-old Owen (Kodi Smit-McPhee) spends his days plotting revenge on his tormentors and spends his nights spying on other residents of the apartment complex. His sole friend is Abby (Chloë Grace Moretz), a strange girl who comes out only at nighttime. Both outcasts, the two form a strong bond. When Abby's caretaker disappears amid a series of gruesome murders, Owen begins to suspect that she is hiding a terrible secret. (Horror, Fantasy, Drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 2010

outtvproud.us.title: Campfire Tales
outtvproud.us.description: On a desolate highway, several stranded teenagers pass the time by telling scary stories around a makeshift fire. (Horror) - 1997

outtvproud.us.title: Sometimes They Come Back... Again
outtvproud.us.description: For years, Jon Porter (Michael Gross) has been repressing memories of how his older sister was murdered -- and how he electrocuted her three assailants to death. Now he must go home for the funeral of his mother, who died under strange circumstances. While in his hometown, Jon's daughter, Michelle (Hilary Swank), makes friends with some of the local girls as well as someone named Tony Reno (Alexis Arquette), who resembles and has the same name as one of the boys her father killed. (Horror) - 1996

outtvproud.us.title: She's Back

outtvproud.us.title: I Could Never Be Your Woman

paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone." (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17
