tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E14 Property Brothers: Emily & Ken With a baby on the way, Emily and Ken are searching for the perfect suburban home close to family. And since their condo sold more quickly than expected, they're crashing in her sister's basement until they find 'the one'.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E16 Property Brothers: George & Jenn In order to cut down on his monster commute, George and Jenn want to move closer to family and friends. And while that's something they both agree on, they're miles apart when it comes to design.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E03 Property Brothers: Monique and Carl Monique and coach Carl have been house hunting for five long years. Luckily, they don't have that kind of time, and with their lease up in only two months, it's time to get decisive.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E10 Property Brothers: Sandi & Phil Sandi and Phil have lived in their park-filled waterfront neighborhood for years. But with the arrival of their baby boy, they've suddenly outgrown their one-room loft-style apartment, and are searching for an allergy-free forever home.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E01 Property Brothers: Tyler and Lindsay Tyler and Lindsay love their waterfront lifestyle, but desperately need a family home where they can put down roots. Drew and Jonathan help them find a property in their exclusive neighborhood with minimal compromise.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E09 Property Brothers: Mark & Eugenie Juggling after-school activities with their careers, Mark and Eugenie haven't had time for house hunting. While the couple has a luxurious list of must-haves, the Property Brothers warn they'll need to compromise if they want to box up their rental.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E15 Property Brothers - Amanda & Tre Tre and Amanda have been living in a rental for nearly three years, and as the kids get bigger their temporary home is getting smaller. They're ready to find a place of their own and are determined to stay in their exclusive lakefront community.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E17 Property Brothers - Rave & Michelle Along with their two little ones, Rave and Michelle are staying with his parents while hunting for the perfect suburban home. And though they're a close-knit family, living under one roof is proving too close for comfort.

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E04 The Ultimate Home for Art Lovers George and Bill are looking to cut their commute and move to the city. They're visiting some of the most desirable properties in Palo Alto, California. Will they find their dream home?

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E03 A Tuscan Escape We meet Alex who is on the lookout for his forever home. Viviana is taking him through some of the most beautiful properties in Santa Barbara, California.

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E10 Sleek Modern or Cozy Farmhouse Eddie and Esperanza are looking for a home that'll cut down their commute. They're visiting some of the most desirable properties in Los Gatos, California. Will they find their dream home?

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E09 From City Streets to Ocean Breeze Doug and Nicole are searching for a new luxury home in Los Angeles, California. They need a house that's closer to their clients and to the beach. Will they find their dream home?

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E05 Beach Vibes & Big Budgets Today we meet Kat. She's looking to find a luxury home near the beach, so Viviana is taking her through some of the most desirable properties in Manhattan Beach, California. She wants to find a house that's close to the action.

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E10 Dreaming Big Estates We meet Michael and Kelly who are in search for a luxury home. Viviana is taking them through some the most beautiful mega mansions in Montecito and Santa Barbara, California.

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E13 A Villa Escape With Classic Charm Darren and Meg are relocating from the East Coast. They're looking for better weather year round. They're visiting some of the most desirable properties in Pasadena, California. The want California living with character and a modern twist.

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E02 Tranquil Park City Escape Savanah is looking for a home in Park City, Utah to escape from her LA lifestyle. As a filmmaker, she's looking for a home that'll inspire her creativity, as well as accommodate industry events during local film festivals.

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E05 Work From Home Meets Garden Goals Gea and David are looking for more space for indoor offices and outdoor entertaining. They're visiting some of the most desirable properties in Cupertino, California. Will they find their dream home?

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E12 A Yoga Haven By The Sea Serena is leaving Seattle for life on the beach. She wants to bring her yoga business to California and live in a home where she can have her yoga studio. She's visiting some of the most desirable properties in Manhattan Beach, California.

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E08 Trading The East For A West Coast Dream Home Selena is looking to move closer to Silicon Valley from the East Coast life that she's been living. She's visiting some of the most desirable properties in Saratoga, California. Will she find her dream home?

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E02 An English Manor in the Golden State Kathy and her husband John are relocating from New York City to sunny California. They're looking for a house that's closer to their family. Will they find their dream home?

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E06 Suite Retreat Nicole and Caffrey design an executive rental suite to help supplement Vashti's path to retirement, while real estate agent Kelsey pursues Nicole and Caffrey's much-needed staging expertise to help sell her clients' colorful and chaotic townhouse.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E08 100 Years Newer After going way over time and budget renovating the main floor of their century home, Jake and Lorraine have run out of steam and need Nicole and Caffrey to take on the second floor before their fast-approaching wedding!

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E01 Paid Off, Styled Up Finally mortgage-free, Denise is now ready for her main floor to go from bleak to chic. Nicole and Caffery will create a maximalist, welcoming space that reflects her larger than life personality!

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E04 Builder Basic to Modern Mohit and Kiru need Nicole and Caffrey to bring a 'styled' look to their very empty new home, and Andrea's trusting her first listing to these staging masters.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E05 A Modern Home and Rental Chrissy's multipurpose home needs help to be as vibrant as Chrissy and her podcast with Marie, while Raymond has a house to sell that needs staging in a hurry.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Vietnamese Pizza in Dalat
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke's next stop is the destination of Dalat. Follow Luke as he visits the Art Deco Dalat Train Station, experiences the French influence of the region with a father and son chef duo, and discovers why Dalat is known as the "Land of Eternal Spring"!

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Exploring The 'Wet Market' Of Nha Trang
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke hops on the train in Ga Thap Cham, and finds himself in Nha Trang—a region of Vietnam with a similar vibe to the French Riviera! Luke hand-catches seafood, looks for some fresh durian fruit, and visits a barramundi farm to harvest sea grapes! (Cooking) - 2020-02-24

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Fiery Chili Sauce in Hoi An
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke is in the town of Hội An. He visits a family who has been making chili sauce for 5 generations, stops by the Historic Japanese Covered Bridge built in 1719, and meets a 4th generation blacksmith who is creating knives from bombshells. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-03

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Seafood With A Bang, Here In Da Nang
tastemadetravel.us.description: On this stop of his Vietnam journey, Luke visits the bustling seaside city of Da Nang. Join him as he visits the spectacular Dragon Bridge, looks up some succulent shrimp on the beach, and stumbles upon a tiny fishing village packed with restaurants. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-10

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Tasty Ant Eggs in Ninh Binh
tastemadetravel.us.description: After a long trip from Hue, Luke finally gets some rest in the scenic Ninh Bihn. Tag along as Luke meets with a local rice farmer, takes a canoe out for some crab hunting, and ventures deep into the jungle in search of a local delicacy- red ant eggs! (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-24

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Searching For The Banh Da Noodle in Hai Phong
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke is in northern Vietnam- Hai Phong! This is the birthplace of his partner Lynne. Join Luke as he meets some of Lynne's family for the first time, and tries the delicious Banh Da Noodle- a tasty dish that Hai Phong is renowned for! (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-31

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Delicious Bun Cha in Hanoi
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke's penultimate stop on his train journey is Hanoi. Follow Luke on his hunt for an iconic Hanoi dish, Bun Cha. Luke takes a ride on the Reunification Express railway, and visits the famous Hoan Kiem Lake for some delicious magenta sticky rice. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-04-07

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Sipping Gin in Sapa
tastemadetravel.us.description: Nearing the end of his Vietnamese journey, Luke stops in Sapa, a hilltop region that he remembers from his travels fifteen years ago. Join Luke as he rekindles a friendship from his previous visit and learns about a local dish of dried buffalo. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-04-14

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Secret Family Recipies in Ho Chi Minh
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke searches to find Ho Chi Minh's old markets before they disappear due to District 1's rapid development. truehistory.us.title: The Celtic World - The Celts and the Classical World
truehistory.us.description: Studying the earliest written records of the Celts from Italy, Greece and Spain, dating as far back as the sixth century B.C.; scholarly theories about the Celts' migration throughout Europe; the foundation of humanity's understanding of the Celts.

truehistory.us.title: The Celtic World - Celtic Art and Artifacts
truehistory.us.description: How archeological studies of Celtic artifacts have woven a rich tapestry of their millennia-old society; learning about war trumpets, gold necklaces and other recovered objects from around Europe; building an image of this ever-adapting culture.

truehistory.us.title: The Celtic World - Celtic Languages in the Ancient World
truehistory.us.description: The discovery of Celtic inscriptions on Spain's western coast; the possibility of a common language along maritime trade routes; revolutionizing studies of Celtic origins and migration; the long-standing theory of Central European Celtic origins.

truehistory.us.title: The Celtic World - Caesar and the Gauls
truehistory.us.description: How several centuries of combat against Celtic-controlled Gaul made northern Italy and southern France a dangerous place for the Romans; Julius Caesar's wars against the Gauls; famous figures of world history and their encounters with the Gauls.

truehistory.us.title: The Celtic World - Celtic Religion and the Druids
truehistory.us.description: Celtic religious beliefs in divination, reincarnation and human sacrifice; discovering the ancient religious figures known as druids, who served as holy men, soothsayers, and even lawyers; an insight into the Celtic version of the sacred.

truehistory.us.title: The Celtic World - Celtic Britain and Roman Britain
truehistory.us.description: The theory of trade-based migration to explain the arrival of the Celts' influence in Britain before the arrival of the Romans; the struggle between the Celts and the Romans over Britain; untangling a web of history on the island. (World history) - 2018-03-30

truehistory.us.title: The Celtic World - Celts and Picts in Scotland
truehistory.us.description: Life in Scotland during the time of a Romanized southern Britain; the warring tribes of Picts that ruled North Britain; highlights that include the ancient Pictish tongue and the truth about William "Braveheart" Wallace. (World history) - 2018-03-30

truehistory.us.title: After the Plague - Resilience: Rethinking the Black Death
truehistory.us.description: The Black Death's pathology and symptoms, and Chaucer's childhood. (World history) - 2022-03-25

truehistory.us.title: After the Plague - Medieval Globalization and the Black Death
truehistory.us.description: Investigating the public health consequences of globalization in the medieval period. (World history) - 2022-03-25

truehistory.us.title: After the Plague - Death Ships: The Spread of Plague in Europe
truehistory.us.description: The plague's continental path and its varying rates of spread. (World history) - 2022-03-25

truehistory.us.title: After the Plague - Children, Plague, and Grief
truehistory.us.description: Bubonic plague's effect on children and how whole towns cared for orphans. (World history) - 2022-03-25

truehistory.us.title: After the Plague - Famine, Flood, and Earthquakes
truehistory.us.description: Exploring how three different kinds of disasters helped Europe mobilize against the plague. (World history) - 2022-03-25

truehistory.us.title: After the Plague - Plague Medicine: Opium, Gold, Poison Clouds
truehistory.us.description: Exploring the role of religion, astrology, the environment and diet in medieval medicine. (World history) - 2022-03-25

truehistory.us.title: After the Plague - Filth: How Medieval Cities Fought the Plague
truehistory.us.description: Exploring how and why premodern cities implemented public health measures before the plague. (World history) - 2022-03-25

truehistory.us.title: After the Plague - Laughter and Joy: Boccaccio's Decameron

unxplainedzone.us.title: The UnXplained

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On a summer afternoon in upscale Lodi, California, a 12-year-old girl is abducted from her home. Scores of police officers and FBI agents converge, determined to find the young girl before it is too late. When the kidnapper's car is discovered in a field near Lodi, police dogs, helicopters, and hundreds of volunteers are employed in a round-the-clock search. It would take a community united in concern for one of their youngest to find the missing child.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In rural Texas, 13-year-old is kidnapped on her way to school. Frantic to find her safely, her millionaire father calls local authorities and the FBI. As police officers and agents conduct aerial surveillance, the father drives hundreds of miles through the night to deliver the ransom cash to a drop that the kidnappers keep changing. In a final effort to save the young girl, investigators must engage in a dangerous firefight with five desperate criminals.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In September 1997, a team of masked gunmen robbed an armored car facility in Los Angeles, and made off with $18.9 million, the largest takeover heist in U.S. history. An employee believed she recognized the voice of one of the robbers, and FBI agents began conducting surveillance on a former employee of the facility. With only one piece of physical evidence, a fragment of a vehicle taillight, authorities hoped to connect him to the crime, and locate his accomplices.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In July 1996, two men entered a pawnshop in Birmingham, Alabama, and ruthlessly murdered the employees. Unbeknownst to the killers, a secret video surveillance camera recorded the shooting. Local police and the FBI released images of the crime to the media, and were quickly able to identify the perpetrators. Now authorities had to find two cold-blooded killers who knew that they were being pursued for murder one.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Lincoln County, Nebraska, a fugitive drug dealer engaged in a shootout with state troopers, wounding two of them, and eluded capture after a high-speed chase. Authorities immediately set up a statewide manhunt, connecting the fugitive to a murder in western Nebraska. A chance sighting led FBI agents to a second confrontation with the killer, who was more determined than ever to escape the law.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: After a career criminal committed a vehicular homicide in New Orleans, FBI agents tracked him through his habits and addictions. They focused their investigation on gambling communities throughout the country and, when he resurfaced in Atlantic City, authorities used all of their resources to trap an elusive sociopath who claimed that he would never be taken alive.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the early 1980's, a pair of serial bank robbers gained a reputation among law enforcement officials as formidable bandits. Using the same modus operandi, the two men took hostages and emptied bank vaults across the Midwest. After the criminals escaped from police custody, FBI agents familiar with the bandits believed that they would attempt a grand-scale heist. By conducting surveillance on known associates of the criminals, authorities tried to anticipate the next target.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the summer of 1999, Texas was terrorized by a brutal serial killer who traveled by train. The FBI assembled a task force to gather information about the dangerous drifter and create a profile that would help locate him. As they learned that the killer had traveled extensively through the United States and Mexico, the murders became more frequent, and authorities had to cast a dragnet over an entire continent in an effort to catch him.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On October 2, 1987, a Boston police officer responding to a domestic disturbance call was fatally wounded. Local authorities launched a citywide manhunt, but were only able to find the fingerprints of the chief suspect. Believing that he had fled the area, the FBI followed the suspect's trail to the west coast and then across the Mexican border, always aware of the desperation of a cop killer and of the need for justice.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In August 1984, the son of a successful real estate developer was kidnapped in front of his father's business in Miami. After the father received a $3 million ransom demand from a self-proclaimed terrorist, the FBI became involved. Based on witness descriptions of the car used in the kidnapping, authorities began to suspect a pair of Colombian nationals with a known grudge against the developer's family.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In October 1995, a South Carolina family was taken hostage as part of an elaborately planned bank robbery. Local police quickly identified two of the perpetrators, but the criminal mastermind proved more elusive. After his escape from custody, authorities began to suspect the fugitive of involvement in a series of bank robberies up and down the east coast, and the FBI remained on his trail, hoping to catch him before he took more hostages.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In February 1988, a record store clerk in Sandusky, Ohio, was fatally shot in his van. After discovering a night deposit bag with thousands of dollars in the vehicle, police knew that robbery was not the motive, and began to investigate other possibilities. FBI agents learned that several motorcycle gang members had been stopped nearby on a traffic violation shortly after the murder and theorized that the clerk's murder may have been a botched hit carried out by a gang member.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In June 1973, a young girl was abducted from a state park on the Missouri River while camping with her family. Several months passed with no leads, then an FBI agent took a particular interest in the case. Using a new technique known as criminal profiling, he predicted that the kidnapper would contact the girl's family on the one-year anniversary of her abduction. When this prediction came true, the FBI agent noted behavioral clues, hoping that they could lead him to the kidnapper.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1996, a group of political extremists twice robbed a bank in Spokane, Washington, using homemade bombs and military precision to escape. The FBI learned that the robbers, part of a shadowy organization called the Phineas Priesthood, might be preparing for a small-scale war with law enforcement. After the suspects were identified, the FBI was faced with the task of safely arresting a group of terrorists with a deadly agenda.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In August 1992, a man returned to his Memphis home and discovered that his wife was missing. The husband, as well as his friends, family and neighbors began to receive ransom calls. FBI agents noticed that one neighbor seemed to have the best rapport with the kidnapper. They began to question his level of involvement, but had to proceed carefully, knowing that he could be their only link to the missing woman.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1990 and 1991, Chicago police and the FBI were on the trail of a bank robber whose holdups were becoming increasingly violent. The criminal consistently used stolen Japanese cars to carry out the robberies, so authorities hoped to identify him by tracking vehicle thefts. When they finally located the man known as the bearded bandit, they learned that he did not work alone and he had made a pact never to surrender.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1988, new light was shed on the mysterious death of a South Carolina farmer when a criminal confessed that two prominent community members hired him to commit murder. Local police and FBI agents arrested a wealthy businessman and later learned that, even behind bars, he commanded the power to corrupt and kill. Using prison informants, agents had to prevent him from murdering again.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In October 1993, a robber surprised unsuspecting customers by dropping through the roof of a California bank. When police arrived, he escaped from the roof in a hail of bullets. A tip from a local resident led police and FBI agents to the perpetrator. They would soon learn that he had masterminded a local kidnapping, and held the fate of an innocent woman in his hands.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In January 1984, a U.S. Customs official disappears from his post near the Del Rio, Texas border crossing, prompting local police to search for four Latin American suspects driving a Pontiac Grand Prix. The following day, the Customs official was found dead. Two state troopers recovered the missing officer's service revolver after a fatal altercation with two men. Local police and the FBI continued searching for the suspect vehicle, prepared for a confrontation with desperate criminals.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Amid the cocaine wars of early 1980's Miami, three dead bodies led a multi-agency tactical squad to suspect that a group of cops might be involved in illegal drug busts. Investigating rumors of corruption, the squad uncovered a ring of patrolmen who were making millions by ripping off smuggled cocaine. The investigators set out to prove that even with the advantages wealth and the protection of a police badge, nobody is above the law.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: At 9:30 am on the morning of January 30, 1997, Richmond, VA police respond to a report of shots fired at a local bank. Two masked men brandishing automatic weapons confront, and open fire on officers responding to the call. The gunmen exit the bank, and retreat on foot, eventually eluding the officers. The FBI soon responds, only to find one bank teller dead, another wounded, and the bank's security guard shot four times, yet still alive.

673500.title: The Caine Mutiny
673500.description: During World War II, a dilapidated vessel, the Caine, gets a new ensign, Willis Keith (Robert Francis), and a new captain, Commander Queeg (Humphrey Bogart). The crew sees Queeg's unconventional behavior as irrational, and communications officer Thomas Keefer (Fred MacMurray) spreads suspicion about his suitability as captain. When a dire situation during a storm forces the executive officer (Van Johnson) to relieve Queeg of his duties, he and Ensign Keith are tried for mutiny.

673500.title: Middle of the Night
673500.description: A May-December romance blooms between a 53-year old widowed clothing manufacturer and an employee 30 years his junior, much to his family’s chagrin.

673500.title: First Men in the Moon
673500.description: Convinced they’re the first men on the moon, three astronauts discover evidence of a lunar landing decades earlier and track down its sole survivor.

673500.title: Paula
673500.description: After her second miscarriage, Paula Rogers (Loretta Young) learns she is sterile. On the way to a reception for her professor husband, John (Kent Smith), a distraught Paula accidentally hits an orphan (Tommy Rettig) with her car. Thinking Paula is drunk, farmer Raymond Bascom (Will Wright) takes the boy to the hospital. Unwilling to confess her role in the hit-and-run for fear of derailing John's career, Paula volunteers at the hospital and helps Davey recover without admitting her guilt.

itvmeridian.uk.description: England are back in action in the Nations League, and take on Spain at the Wanda Metropolitano, the home of Atletico Madrid. The two teams met back in September where the World Champions ran out 3-2 winners at Wembley.
